draft.title: Does merging DeepSeekR1, QwQ, and SkyT1 into FuseO1 improve date calculation accuracy over DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B?
draft.body:
A 2025 Reddit post shared a Fusion model called FuseO1-DeepSeekR1-QwQ-SkyT1-32B-Preview, which merges DeepSeekR1, QwQ, and SkyT1 32B models. The user tested this merged model against DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B using ollama with a 32k context and Q8_0 KV Cache.

The key question is whether combining these models actually yields better accuracy on tasks like date calculations, or if the merge introduces tradeoffs that might impact specific capabilities. Since the test environment details are limited, it’s unclear how generalizable the results are.

Has anyone else compared merged models like this to their base components for date or time-related reasoning? What practical differences have you observed in accuracy or consistency?
